notes.title: Response: Support & Criticism for the New Version
notes.notes:
‌Recently, some friends who preferred the previous version have contributed to an increase in lower ratings.



I too enjoyed the relaxed experience of the old version. Unfortunately, its gameplay had reached a developmental dead end.
The art overhaul stems from these reasons:
[olist]
Aligning with the new thematic direction. Without showcasing the world's brutal competition, gameplay would stagnate. My focus is societal evolution—remaining a casual builder contradicts this vision.

Previous art, while detailed, compromised clarity for controls and interactions.

It also caused performance issues during late-game scaling.

Facial/hair/clothing diversity will return—currently delayed due to workload.
[/olist]
To those dissatisfied with our direction: I regret any communication gaps. I shared development visuals and beta explanations, but clearly fell short. My sincere apologies.

This update demanded extraordinary effort. By March 2024 (launch month), I recognized the old design's ceiling. Some team members began prototyping this new version then, while maintaining old updates until October 2024—despite steadily declining player counts and sales. Minor optimizations couldn't revive stagnant gameplay.

The conclusion is undeniable: the old path led nowhere.



The new version is now playable.
Player counts, sales, and reception have surged dramatically these past days. I'm grateful to the team members who persevered. ‌The team has even welcomed new members.

We'll press forward—hoping supporters of this vision stay with us.



P.S. Group marriage remains current. Family trees and kinship systems will reemerge as core mechanics, evolving the game into the era of familial invention.

Compact Gameplay:

Conquer the world-one breakthrough at a time.

Each run is a new experiment:

Early Rush • Cultural influence • Trade/Slavery • Granary Migration • Enforce other tribes to tribute or become your vassal.

Combine these approaches, then restart to pursue new paths after each breakthrough.


‌Ancient Nations Competition‌
We added simple grand strategy gameplay to colony-building mechanics.

You will lead a branch of ‌Ancient Chinese, starting by building a small tribe: crafting tools, constructing houses, hunting, farming, and raising livestock.

Then face 5 ethnic groups in Asia: ‌Rongdi, Baiyue, Ancient Chinese States, Aryans, Assyrians‌.

From the eastern Yellow River basin to Mesopotamia – rule or be ruled.
‌Tech Tree & Culture Tree‌
You can develop culture to make other tribes submit, pay tribute, and provide ‌vassal troops + supplies‌.

Or gain advanced tools and bronze through technological advantage for trade.

Or prioritize reproduction through ‌fertility worship‌.

Or embrace violence, train professional soldiers, and plunder extensively.
‌Manage Slaves‌
Force lifelong labor, OR adopt them into your tribe to bear children.

Execute slaves to suppress rebellions, OR sell them directly.
‌Leaders & Grouping‌
Use Leaders to manage groups, reducing repetitive actions.

Set group schedules: labor, create culture, develop tech, or train.

Battlefield controls function like traditional RTS unit groups.

Future update: Group leaders will become a higher social class.
‌Knowledge Inheritance‌
Tribesmen gain knowledge through labor – lost when they die.

Must carve knowledge onto stone monuments to preserve it.

These monuments become learning tools for future generations.




Next Steps
We will continue refining gameplay, optimizing late-game performance, and fixing reported bugs.  

Major planned additions (order/details subject to change):

Remove mammoths' watering ability → Replace with **expedition capability** enabling East/West Asia connectivity in late-game  

Human-operated irrigation upgrades will supersede mammoth watering (resolves conflicts with cattle)  

Add **quick combat option** to alleviate late-game repetition/performance issues  

Introduce **specialized storage** for item categories  

Attacking enemies should suffer **population attrition**  

Successful defenses should yield **battlefield loot**  

Aryans and Assyrians turn hostile upon bordering player territory  

**Combat system overhaul** for deeper mechanics  

**Diplomacy system redesign** for enhanced strategic depth  

Revamp **fertility cult visuals** (current implementation lacks impact)  

Development of family structures and private ownership systems.  

-BigDove

notes.title: NEW BETA AVAILABLE - UPDATE 0.3 IS AT THE BETA BRANCH NOW
notes.notes:
Hello Great Leaders!

It is finally time for some news, we are working on it for several months, thank you for your patience so far!First part of the post we will give some explanations of the direction of the game and later we will present the new good stuff!

Sim Colony x Grand Strategy
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680212/a4b38ccda4e5be31ed9bff63daf93aaf488d4d3c.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680212/f38c63c97b0d16f2afae6603d96f70271fb3ff3b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680212/c6eeb52d0ce4410d3484c17487bab31daa172f5c.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680212/abcc800ea56443acbd1f5463de0e32bf1637b9e3.png"]
This isn't a Traditional Sim Colony:


The Traditional Ones might be focused on "survival", with a lot of natural disasters and surviving rounds of bugs, zombies, or invaders or it can be about logistics management, space planning, building pipes, conveyor belts, waterways, etc., in order to efficiently move goods around and expand production.


Primitive Society Simulator will be a "Building Society":


We have currently incorporated "competition with other peoples," essentially merging grand strategy gameplay with "map coloring" mechanics.
Players must prevail in this fiercely competitive world.

We hope our friends maintain realistic expectations regarding our development progress. We will gradually create a work centered on shaping and building society within the context of human conflict.

Management remains a crucial cornerstone – you must develop your tribe effectively, then exert influence over neighboring tribes, turning them into vassals to achieve greater expansion.
Here, war will serve as an extension of politics, though not the sole method; cultural propagation and trade are equally viable paths.



This game is not the traditional way of playing colony building, and that competition, i.e. war, diplomacy, commerce and trade will be very important, and that just building on your own in silence will not win you the game.


Important Differences Compared To The Old Version:

1. It's now impossible to directly unlock technology through labor accumulation


This old mechanic can lead to players not being able to make choices on technology development. It is very detrimental to the playstyle.

I like the old mechanic myself, but it's a temporary compromise for the sake of smooth gameplay and the more important leader system, so I hope you understand.

The mechanism now is that the leader creates the technology by leading the crowd, working together, and gathering the wisdom of all.

Knowledge remains an important factor, and with insufficient knowledge, technology creation will be slow beyond the medium term.

The engraving of monuments and the passing on of knowledge is still alive and well and remains a more important play.

We will also continue to design better ways to play to reflect the importance of knowledge. Keep up the playstyle exploration of this factor.


2. New art style


The detail (texture) is reduced. On the one hand this is better for post performance.

On the other hand, I think being able to clearly see what people are doing is very important for this work.

The characters have become more slender than in the past, and the movements are more realistic, especially the fighting ones.

There's still a lot of room for improvements, but the overall presentation of the art style is much more appropriate for this game than in the past.

Scenery details will be further enriched by adding buildable facilities.


3. Some other removed features:
Mission, Founding, Oracle. It will be replaced later by a richer system of diplomacy and events.

Terrain modification. Shouldn't be done again, huge amount of work, other games do it more.

But the mound of dirt and the altar are still there. They are now used for cultural outreach.

The "Smoothing Point" is removed, and the need for "emotional pacification" is gone. Now there's no more being scared to death out of fear.

There are no specialized medical beds. Serious injuries are treated by prioritizing placement in beds, and if beds are not available, they will be placed next to the campfire.


Highlights, added gameplay:

1. Strategic gameplay - Ancient ethnic rivalry and the corresponding map


The player starts in East Asia.

The player can take slaves and food from other tribes.

They can also pay tribute to other tribes or be turned into military service by "propagandizing" them.

There are no more complex strategic gameplay options such as marriages.

The localized battlefield has simple weapon restraints and training of soldiers. There are chariots as siege equipment.


2. Technology Tree


In the past, the tech tree was accumulated by knowledge and unlocked by itself. The player had no choice. Now it has been changed to, the leader leads the clan and conducts research together. The speed of research is mainly affected by collective intelligence, but also by the amount of knowledge.

The content of the tech tree has been increased mainly by city defense. Other tech points have changed little.


3. Cultural Trees


This can be done through culture, controlling population growth, weapon quality, training effectiveness, and outreach effectiveness. Four broad areas.

It is likewise up to the leader to lead the clan and create.


4. "Leader" centered grouping function


There are related leader schedules, martial arts, and dietary management.

It's very convenient to operate in the middle and late stage. All kinds of interactions are centered on the leader.


5. Group marriages


It's not a monogamous union now. Children don't know who their father is.

It doesn't have much impact at the moment. The main thing is to lay the groundwork for play styles down the road.

For example, an imbalance in the ratio of men to women can cause a difference in playstyle, where women are more numerous and the population reproduces faster.

And more males in greater numbers, with greater war power.

This is also more in line with history, and lays the foundation for future "family" and "class" mechanics.


6. Slave management


Slaves are great laborers, but they can also rebel.

Rebellion can be deterred by execution, or it can take a leader's time to turn them into clansmen or sold.


7. Medicine is now automatic


You don't have to send squads out to find medicine anymore, the people who work in medicine will find it themselves.

Serious injuries are now 0 blood, but they won't die immediately, they will be saved by others, and will only die if no one saves them at intervals.


Known major issues


※ Performance can't hold up after the population explosion in the later stages. We have already designed a way to play against "too many people", but it will take time to fix it.

※ Localization still a work in progress while it is on Beta. We will be updating it always that the each translator make some progress. Russian and Spanish might be unplayable for now, once that our translators are facing personal problems.



Also being a Beta branch, there should be more or less a few bugs and numerical issues that we haven't found yet.



We hope you will give us more encouragement.



-Peterson Bueno, Mr. Octopus

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.0_604.1341 - Italian Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear community!!

Ever since we started planning this game, our dream was to make it as accessible as possible to all the communities around the world. It's certainly a bold goal which, little by little, with your constant support, we're managing to achieve.

Our achievements so far:

 Before the launch, we did a lot of research so that the standard price of the game and the regional price were adjusted according to the realities of each community, with values as low as possible so that we could continue working on our ambitious project (including values well below those recommended by Steam).
 A few days after the launch, we discovered that in some communities the game was still not at a good price, so we reduced the price of the game for these communities, so that it was in line with their reality.
 We hired translators so that the game could be translated into several languages from launch, and these translators are accompanying us throughout this journey, they are being exceptional, much gratitude for their work.
 We've changed the font and made it possible to adjust the size of the UI, thus eliminating headaches for players with smaller screens.
 We recently added the possibility of removing the movement of vegetation, which was making some people sick (in fact, only one person reported this to us, and as it was within our power, we did it immediately).

We are a very small team and without your support we would never have made it this far, we are very grateful for everything you have done for us so far:

 Buying the game.
 Writing reviews (positive or negative) helps us to improve our game. It's true that the negative ones shake us up a bit, we're human, but we keep going.
 Participating in our Discord server.
 Participating in the Steam Discussions tab.
 Putting the game on your wish list.
 Sharing our game with your friends.
 Presenting our game on your channels and social media.

In other words, you are extraordinary!!!

In gratitude for everything you are doing for us, we are:

 Translating the game to even more languages so that more communities can have access to the game. Our translators have recently finished translating the game into Italian. However, adding a new language means that a lot can still be messed up. Please if you find anything odd, don't hesitate to contact us.
 Korean is coming soon as well but since it uses a very unique alphabet it is taking a llittle longer to implement, but it is coming!!
 We're also working hard to bring you more content, performance improvements and much more. In all, since the game has been available in Early Access (since February 28, 2024) there have been 22 small updates (including this one), 2 standard updates and 1 major update.
 In parallel with the minor updates, we're working on a major update that will bring a lot of content and graphical changes so that the game can support our future dreams without draining all of yours and ours computers...

In summary, we are very grateful for your constant support, we are working tirelessly and if we can ask for anything: Invest your trust in our work and we will be doing everything in our power to repay that trust.

Here the notes from this small Update:

Bug Dixes

The animal from the Beast Quest has a green blood bar.
You would be wandering around during the Beast Quest.

Sincerely,
-YSH Mr. Octopus

notes.title: UI & GAME PACING UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello wonderful people!

After receiving a lot of feedback from you, we're finally bringing our first Big Update. Here we're setting a new tone for how we'll be approaching the game's UI, as well as looking to solve the problems related to the gaming pace.

At the end of this post you can find more about the frequency of our future updates.

We've prepared a very simple video to show you some of the changes we've made. The video is also on our new YouTube channel. Previously our posts were made on our personal accounts (sorry about that). By subscribing there, you'll be kept up to date with all the latest news on the game.

Here is the video and right below you will find the description of the changes we've made:

[previewyoutube=-SOnukSUeyE;full][/previewyoutube]

Notion of Time

 The exact time is not visible now, only the seasons.
 The exact time will be unlocked later through the concept of creating time.

UI Style

 The UI now has a new, still relatively simple style.
 Changes will continue to be made in this area.

Life Expectancy

 It used to start with 8 people, but this number has increased to 10.
 Your people will live faster, it means, they will age faster and die faster.

The Diurnal Cycle

 The days are longer now: From 20 seconds to 30 seconds an hour.
 They used to sleep about 7 hours, now they sleep only 5 hours.

Interaction Optimization

 The expedition team now automatically calculates the food required. No more doing the math yourself every time.
 A new master and apprentice management interface. You don't have to go from one to the other to click on the master at a later stage.

Rhythm of Technological Invention

 Farmland on tech tree, moved from level 4, forward to level 3
 Wooden Plow on tech tree, moved from level 5, forward to level 4
 Brown millet also moved back one level.

Late Years Gameplay

 The urgency and manpower needed to help other tribes was increased.
 The invasions became more frequent in the later stages.

Compatibility

 Most archives will be fine.
 Some may face compatibility problems, so you have two options:
[olist]
 Restart the game. Enjoy and try all the available modifications right from the start.
 Contact us (Discord, Steam Discussions) to see if anything can be done in your specific case.
[/olist]
The overall pace of the game seems to have doubled.

This is how we are going to be working from now on:

[Small Updates] Bug fixes, performance optimization: 1~2 times per week.
[Updates] Interaction optimization, new features with small changes: once every 2~4 weeks.
[Big Updates] Changes to greater play: once every 4~6 months.

-YSH Mr. Octopus

notes.title: Demo beta branch update - 2023.7.19
notes.notes:
---------- 2023.7.19_beta branch ----------
Changelog (0.4.0.719.1149_beta branch)
New features:
Chickens and sheeps will now mate autonomously, manual pairing for these animals is removed
Added a new storage area with the ability to designate specific areas, old storage area removed
*Old storage areas built in previous saves will be preserved but cannot be constructed anymore
This update is compatible with old save files.

notes.title: Demo Patch，6.20~7.4
notes.notes:
---------- 2023.6.20 ----------
New tutorial and interaction improvements:
Added operation guides for building a campfire, constructing a crafting table, crafting tools, storing food, building shed, making beds, and creating inventions.
Adjusted the click range for locusts.
Doctor's priority shifted higher than sleeping .

Bug fixes:
Dire wolf won't continue attacking after killing someone.
English feedback questionnaire now directly redirects to Discord.
Herbs team numbers were not incrementing, always showing 0.
Players were able to make the traders of other tribes return their equipment, causing errors.
Clothing taken from or placed on a clothing rack would have incorrect quantities after loading a saved game.
Mining steps in tutorial couldn't be completed.
Unable to sell more than one dog.
After harvesting crops in a field, loading a save file would cause the crop stakes to not be displayed.
Players could make the traders accept apprenticeship, leading to errors. 

.
.
.
---------- 2023.6.21 ----------
Optimizations:
Dedicated storage facilities (such as weapon racks) with the same priority will now sort items from storage accordingly.
Rearranged the layout of the new player guide in the top left corner.
If the save file path space is not sufficient, you will be prompted to free up space (please clean up your system drive, we kindly request your cooperation).

Bug fixes:
New player guide could cause errors when loading a save file. 
Child picking flowers on a high platform could cause the game to freeze.
Fence material error.
Young animals that are not gentle enough won't go berserk on the first day they are brought back to the enclosure.
Save files with formatting errors could cause initialization failure on the title screen. 
2023.6.21.23
Bug fixes:
Ultra-wide screen adaptation
Adjusted the selection box for buildings, it should feel more comfortable now as the selection box perfectly corresponds to the collision area on click.

Buildings in the list now have icons.

Fixed issues with reading files in the English version that caused number errors and various display issues.

Fixed the issue where health bars on repaired buildings would not disappear.

Unable to hunt for young animals.
Item quantities and animal pen food are not displayed.
Stone tablets and story points on platforms are not properly connected;

Optimizations:
Modified the spawning mechanism for wild chicken and wild sheep herds. After the spawning interval, the population will be replenished to the desired number (previously, it was required to be below the "4 herds" to replenish).

Bugs Fixed:
Error when demolishing certain buildings, such as farms.
If an animal companion dies in the beast hunting map and the game is loaded, the character will attempt to retrieve meat and get stuck in the corner of the map.

Optimizations:
Added a confirmation popup when giving gifts to prevent accidental clicks.

Bugs Fixed:
Error when generating random names for new games.
In the English version, some objectives in the tutorial cannot be completed.
Bodies of deceased characters and animal companions in the beast hunting map do not disappear.

beasts crazy can trigger tutorial combat tasks now.

Bugs Fixed:
Inability to construct various earth buildings.

Bug Fixes:
In the quest "Distant Friends," tribes that are respected but not considered friendly are now correctly counted.
Animals that reach the age threshold are not immediately evaluated for automatic slaughter.
Completing the Invader quest does not count towards the completion counter.
Resources that no longer need to be gathered are still being collected.

notes.title: FreeDemo Update, Tutorial, Taming
notes.notes:
Tutorial:
【Mining】【Setting Mining Quantity】【Hunting】【Search for Herbs】【Potion Crafting】
There are still many more to add, it will take time.

Important Optimizations:
Tamed animal priority adjusted to 2, right after feeding.
Chicken daily food consumption changed to 2.
Added difficulty options, 5 levels from "Peaceful" to "Challenging".
Set the difficulty when starting a new game.
Refill the animal pen feed trough when it's empty.
Raincoats will no longer be repeatedly equipped and unequipped.
Add a Input box for maintaining resource quantity.

Other Optimizations:
No need for a bed to get married.
When invaders are killed after stealing food, the stolen food will drop,.
"Gate" models now have directionality.
Meat racks are now set to "Allow Retrieval" by default.

Bugs:
When lying on a bed, severely ill characters would drop to the ground and couldn't be clicked.
Characters not dying after being hungry for ten days.
Invasion difficulty option in the load game menu showing 100 instead of the correct value.
Interrupted ceremonies at 7 AM if they were already in progress.
People falling off at the connection between walls and defense platforms.
Floating grass on the screen.
Characters getting stuck at a height where they can't walk due to model collision.
Various bugs related to ceremonies.
Animal pens being copyable during construction and demolition.
Automatic slaughter age setting not working.
If people and food are selected for a ritual but then the interface is closed, when the ceremony is performed later, people or food may be missing, causing various bugs.
